QuestInfo.name: Korean Folk Town Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Chumji in the Korean Folk Town has a request regarding the Haenim siblings.
QuestInfo.1: Chumji wants to make clothes and blankets for the Haenim siblings, who have been bravely living on their own without their parents. He needs you to get Quilting Cotton from the monsters at Black Mountain, and bring them back to him.
QuestInfo.2: Chumji in the Korean Folk Town asked you to get Quilting Cotton from the monsters at Black Mountain so he could create clothes and blankets for the Haenim siblings. When you brought him the Quilting Cotton, Chumji happily got to work preparing the Haenim siblings for winter.

0.0: Hey, traveler. Want to cultivate your virtues by performing good deeds?\r\n#L0##bWhat do you mean by good deeds? What can I help you?#l\n#k
0.1: Do you know the Haenim siblings? They were separated from their parents at a young age, but still manage to put on a cheerful face. Winter is just around the corner, and I'm a little worried about them. I want to make clothes and blankets to keep them warm, but I am short of Quilting Cotton.  Can you help me?

yes.0: The monsters in Black Mountain have Quilting Cotton. The more of it you can get me, the better. How about 20 handfuls of it?\n\n#b#i4032568# #t4032568# x 20

no.0: How can those young kids survive this harsh winter?
